public.text: Civil registration, vital statistics, and national geospatial registries are categorically placed in foundational DPI. In some countries, CRVS or geospatial services may not be governed or delivered as DPI, and health may operate sector-specific capabilities.
public.suggestedRevision: Describe these as potential foundational or cross-sector authoritative capabilities. Where unavailable, health may maintain interim functionality with an explicit integration and transition plan.
